caption: Piazza del Popolo, Todi
composition: Romanesque cathedral above the sloping civic square · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the foot of the sloping piazza the camera looks up the cobbles to the Romanesque cathedral facade centered above. Stone palaces with ground-floor arcades flank the square on left and right, and the hills rise behind. The 08:38 morning sun gilds the stone, the piazza empty.
